answer: Agents selling cedar nest boxes for a sparrow garden count sales toward reputation only when buyer and seller have different verified beneficial owners. A registrar binds every trading key to its controlling owner; the scoring engine compares those owner IDs before crediting a sale. Trading between a thousand aliases of one owner therefore earns no reputation, even when funds move. This blocks self-dealing sybil reviews, assuming accurate ownership checks; colluding independent owners can still evade it.
